Multiple Indian Companies See Stock Market Listings and Dividend Announcements

Several Indian companies experienced significant stock market activity, with ESDS Software Solution, Priority Jewels, and Lumino Industries making their stock market debuts. ESDS Software Solution shares hit a 20% upper circuit on debut, trading at ₹895.55 on BSE and ₹908.40 on NSE, after its IPO was oversubscribed 135.88 times. Priority Jewels listed at a 15% premium on NSE, having sold shares in the price band of ₹190-200. Lumino Industries also saw a decent debut, listing at a 34% premium. Separately, TVS Holdings is set to allot bonus shares, with its record date approaching. Kajaria Ceramics announced a ₹6 final dividend per share for FY26, with a record date of September 21, 2026, and a ₹296.7 crore share buyback. Cochin Shipyard and GRSE have also set September 18 as the record date for their respective final dividends of ₹1.50 and ₹6.70 per share.
